sentences.text: Dated this the 10th day of July, 2025 Petitioner is the accused in C.C. No.666 of 2024 pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IX, Ernakulam, which originated from Crime No.1657 of 2016 registered at the Palarivattom Police Station for the offence punishable under Section 420 r/w Section 34 of IPC.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IX, Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner's failure to appear in court after his enlargement on bail, has resulted in issuance of non bailable warrant against him.

2. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that his client's failure to appear in court was not willful and though is desirous of surrendering in court, he is apprehensive that the bail application will not be considered on the day of surrender.
I heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

Considering the limited relief sought, the Crl.M.C. is disposed of with the following directions;
i) The petitioner shall surrender and move an application for bail before the jurisdictional court within two weeks with advance notice to the Public Prosecutor.
ii) If petitioner surrenders within the time granted, learned Magistrate shall pass orders on the application for bail on the day of surrender itself.
iii) Execution of the non-bailable warrant pending against the petitioner shall be kept in abeyance for two weeks.

Sd/-
